en.answer: If <<11771>> is not in your Graveyard when its second effect resolves, the effect of returning it to the Deck cannot be applied.
en.question: If the second effect of <<11771>> is activated in the Graveyard, but my opponent chains the effect of <<6980>> so that <<11771>> is no longer in the Graveyard when its effect resolves, is the effect applied?
en.title: If the second effect of <<11771>> is activated in the Graveyard, but my opponent chains the effect of <<6980>> so that <<11771>> is no longer in the Graveyard when its effect resolves, is the effect applied?

ja.answer: 墓地にて効果を発動した「<<11771>>」が、効果処理時に墓地に存在しなくなった場合には、『このカードをデッキの一番上または一番下に戻す』処理は適用されません。
